checkpoint: journey_vault_browse (drilled into Journey Clips — wide/16:9 card level)
comment: J1-Vault. Against the Vault Browse face ONE LEVEL DEEP, drilled into the fixture's plain 'Journey Clips' folder — the point where VaultPage.qml's browseGridWide gate (root.browseGridRows[0].nodeType is 'episode'/'clip') switches the grid's delegate from VaultPosterCard (2:3) to VaultWideCard (16:9), per the locked design's own rule that drilling into a clip/episode level is a DIFFERENT card, not the same grid one level deeper. 'wideCardArtIsWideCardShaped' is this checkpoint's card-aspect/layout rule: it holds today because a VaultWideCard's own '_art' Rectangle is exactly card-width wide (see VaultWideCard.qml) and sits inside the app window — the mandatory negative control (journey_vault_browse_clips-negative-card-aspect.json) re-points its viewport at a POSTER card's much narrower, differently-positioned '_art' box instead, which the real wide card's art genuinely cannot fit inside, turning exactly this rule red without touching any QML.
